basic_details.job_title: VTU Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, invites applications from eligible Indian nationals for the VTU Post-Doctoral Fellowship (VTU-PDF) - 2026. Post-doctoral candidates submit their applications with a research proposal, and shortlisted candidates present the proposal and attend an interview. Online application submission for VTU-PDF supervisor registration opens on 1 December 2026. Eligibility, fellowship benefits, regulations and the application formats are published on the official VTU website.

how_to_apply: The notice says the eligibility criteria, fellowship benefits, regulations and prescribed application formats are on the official VTU website. Interested and eligible candidates should visit the VTU website and submit their applications, with research proposals, within the stipulated deadline. This notice does not give that deadline. The only date it prints is the opening of online supervisor registration on 1 December 2026.
Application in the prescribed format, available on the VTU website

content_sections.text: The notice does not specify the number of fellowships, the last date, the application fee, the age limit or the fellowship amount. It states that these details are on the official VTU website.

content_sections.heading: About VTU
content_sections.text: Visvesvaraya Technological University is a State University of the Government of Karnataka, established under the VTU Act, 1994, with its campus at "Jnana Sangama", Belagavi-590018, Karnataka. The notice states that the VTU-PDF aims to promote frontier-oriented, interdisciplinary and high-impact research, nurture emerging research talent, encourage innovation and technology development, and strengthen VTU's research excellence and global research engagement. The fellowship seeks to support promising researchers working on contemporary scientific, technological and societal challenges.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The fellowship is open to eligible post-doctoral candidates who are Indian nationals. The notice does not print the educational qualification, age limit or experience requirement. It states that the detailed eligibility criteria are on the official VTU website. Check the official notification and the VTU website for the full eligibility for the fellowship. The programme also has a separate stage for VTU faculty members. Eligible VTU faculty members apply for empanelment as approved supervisors under the VTU Post-Doctoral Fellowship programme. This stage is supervisor registration, not the fellowship application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice says the eligibility criteria, fellowship benefits, regulations and prescribed application formats are on the official VTU website. Interested and eligible candidates should visit the VTU website and submit their applications, with research proposals, within the stipulated deadline. This notice does not give that deadline. The only date it prints is the opening of online supervisor registration on 1 December 2026. Documents named in the notice: Application in the prescribed format, available on the VTU website Research proposal

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The VTU-PDF 2026 runs in three stages: Stage 1 – Supervisor Registration: eligible VTU faculty members apply for empanelment as approved supervisors. Stage 2 – Fellowship Applications: eligible post-doctoral candidates submit applications along with research proposals. Stage 3 – Selection: shortlisted candidates are invited to present their research proposals and attend an interview. The notice does not give the date or the mode of the presentation and interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the VTU Post-Doctoral Fellowship (VTU-PDF) 2026?
